title: Financial-crime investigation bundle
description: Suspicious-activity review, issue management, and regulatory reporting evidence.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: fs-financial-crime-investigation
  title: Financial-crime investigation bundle
  description: Suspicious-activity review, issue management, and regulatory reporting evidence.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-cross-03
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/financial-services
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [customer_party.subject_name, compliance_case.suspicious_activity_type, compliance_case.issue_id, regulatory_filing.report_name]
      relationshipIds: [subject_of, reported_through]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/fs/aml_sar, role: review }
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/fs/issue_management_record, role: exception }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/fs/regulatory_reporting_package, role: supporting }
